selection_policy: Select only candidates that survive the IdeaSpark hard floor, retain a falsifiable mechanism delta after direct-neighbor comparison, and fit the confirmed compute envelope.

candidates.title: ClaimProbe: Paired Micro-Reproduction Predicts Cost-Adjusted Paper Utility
candidates.reason: The eight-row, at-most-four-paper instrument cannot support cross-paper sign/rank calibration, and the proposed cost ledger does not deliver the cited deconfounding recipe.

candidates.title: BoundaryProbe: Task-Conditioned Perturbations Reveal When Paper Methods Pay Off
candidates.reason: The central mechanism repackages causal transportability and local response-surface analysis for paper adoption, with insufficient scope for the general claim.

candidates.title: Sequential Decision-Value Triage for Task-Specific Paper Reproduction
candidates.reason: Cost-sensitive multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization already subsumes value-per-cost probe selection and automatic stopping; changing the application object is not a mechanism delta.

candidates.title: LocalClaim: Compiling Papers into Task-Locked Operator Trials
candidates.reason: The method is ordinary component ablation moved to a paper-operator granularity and lacks semantic-validity and executable-coverage guarantees.

candidates.title: FactorGate: Four-Cell Mechanism-Contract Attribution for Locked-Task Paper Reuse
candidates.reason: The load-bearing design is a classical 2x2 factorial attribution assembled from existing compilers, validators, runners, and scorers.

candidates.title: Task-Specific Obligation Witnesses for Minimal Paper Reproduction
candidates.reason: The proposal combines source-map extraction, program slicing, delta debugging, graph checking, and deletion tests without a new load-bearing component.

candidates.title: EffectSlice: Source-Grounded Certificates for Task-Local Paper Effects
candidates.reason: Without a positive-full-effect eligibility gate, a negligible complete artifact can receive a vacuous preservation certificate; the smallest-slice claim is also unsupported.

candidates.title: EffectSlice: Eligibility-Gated Certificates for Task-Local Procedural Effects
candidates.reason: The eligibility rule still permits a degenerate no-skill-equivalent or empty slice, and atomization plus the alpha ledger remain underspecified.

candidates.title: EffectSlice: Eligibility-Gated Certificates for Task-Local Procedural Effects
candidates.reason: The nonempty gate, epsilon <= delta_min/2 rule, deterministic atom compiler, exact SCC quotient, complete sealed hypothesis family, direct-neighbor matched admission test, and reducer-agnostic claim remove the prior hard-floor defects. Novelty remains provisional because collision retrieval is degraded and older behavior-preserving reduction families are unresolved.

selection_conclusion: Only EffectSlice v3 is sufficiently defensible to hand to Stage 2. It is not an established novel result yet; it is a falsifiable, implementable candidate with an explicit targeted scoop-check risk.
